page_title: CAG 0-4 NAP | Cagliari v Napoli 15/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.

90+3' 0 - 4 Goal! Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) jumps highest inside the box to meet the resulting corner from David Neres. His well-placed header ends up in the top of the net, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. 0:4.
90+2' Good work from Napoli as they win a corner.
90+1' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) is penalised for a foul. Federico La Penna had a clear view and blows his whistle.
87' Napoli are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
84' Wonderful movement by Cagliari. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
82' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and David Neres (Napoli) comes onto the pitch so that Matteo Politano can be given a rest.
80' Cagliari show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
78' Davide Nicola decides to make a substitution. Roberto Piccoli will be replaced by Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
77' Substitution. Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) has come on for Razvan Marin.
76' Napoli couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Simone Scuffet (Cagliari) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
75' Today's referee Federico La Penna rightly decides to book Yerry Mina (Cagliari) for his harsh tackle.
74' Substitution. Stanislav Lobotka will be replaced by Billy Gilmour (Napoli).
74' Here is a change. Romelu Lukaku is going off and Antonio Conte gives the last tactical orders to Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).
74' It will be a substitution. Scott McTominay (Napoli) is ready to enter the pitch as Khvicha Kvaratskhelia walks off.
70' 0 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia is the provider as he slips the ball to Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 0:3.
70' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
70' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

66' 0 - 2 Goal! A terrific long pass from Romelu Lukaku picks out an unmarked Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
64' That will be all from Leonardo Spinazzola who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mathias Olivera (Napoli).

63' Kingstone Mutandwa (Cagliari) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
62' Ball possession – 48:52.
61' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Cagliari.
59' The referee signals a substitution. Kingstone Mutandwa is brought on as a substitute for Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari).
59' Matteo Politano (Napoli) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
59' That's the end of the game for Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari), who is replaced by Nadir Zortea.
57' Federico La Penna shows the yellow card to Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) for a heavy challenge.
56' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal.
54' Cagliari failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

54' The ball falls for Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) in the box, and he hits a first-time shot at goal that is inadvertently blocked by a defender. A bit unlucky there! The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' Matteo Politano (Napoli) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
51' Napoli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
48' The ball falls kindly for Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the right post.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) comes off for Michel Adopo.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+9' Federico La Penna blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+9' Cagliari have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

45+8' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety. Corner kick. Cagliari will have an opportunity.
45+5' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort that ends well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.

45+5' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Napoli are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
45+3' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
45+1' The linesman raises his flag. Matteo Politano (Napoli) is adjudged offside.
45+1' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
44' Matteo Politano (Napoli) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
44' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Napoli have a corner.
42' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) for a tough tackle.
42' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.

41' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes to stop the effort. The ball is out of play. Cagliari will have a chance to score from a corner.
41' The referee blows his whistle, Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.
38' The resulting corner, taken by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli), comes to nothing.
37' Napoli take a quick free kick with a short pass and play continues.
35' The resulting set piece from Cagliari is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
33' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
30' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
29' The shots on goal statistics – 1:2.
26' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
24' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
24' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
21' Federico La Penna has a clear sight and sees a foul from Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari).
20' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

20' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Alex Meret thwarts him with a great two-handed save. The ball is out of play. Cagliari win a corner kick.
18' 0 - 1 Goal! Romelu Lukaku passes the ball to Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Simone Scuffet couldn't do anything about it. 0:1.
17' Federico La Penna blows for a foul after Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Napoli have a free kick.
16' Half-chance! Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) plays a pass into the box, but Simone Scuffet reacts well to snuff out the attack.
14' A dangerous looking corner kick from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is cleared to safety by the defence.
13' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
11' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Federico La Penna who sees an offensive foul. Cagliari have a free kick.
9' The foul by Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) was seen by Federico La Penna who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

8' Napoli slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
6' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
5' Cagliari are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
3' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
2' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
1' The referee blows his whistle as Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) was too aggressive in his challenge.
1' The match has just started.
The referee of today's match will be Federico La Penna.
